meta.title: DSH tools
meta.description: Three desktop utilities: 1) a More menu in the Windows caption bar offering Restart DSH — one click restarts immediately (⚠ running tasks are interrupted, no confirmation dialog); 2) a Generate button in the composer that drafts an intended reply from the last assistant message and fills it into the input box; 3) terminal-style input history — press ArrowUp/ArrowDown in the composer to cycle through the messages you sent in this session, past the newest one your draft is restored. The titlebar button is desktop-only; nothing is added in a plain browser.
